text.body:
[subhāsiyapajjasaṅgahō]
[p. 76]
kiṁ bhaṇimō navajuvaīṇa tāṇa savvaṅgacaṅgimasuhassa
diṭṭhītibhāyaphaṁsē vi jāṇamamayaṁ pi hu na kipi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.1
gayanēvacchā vacchē! aïdusahā taṁ si taruṇanayaṇāṇa
vammahakarasaṅgahiyā nippaḍiyāra vva khaggalayā // SubhāPajjSaṁ.2
diṭṭhīē tassa sasaharakarasalilajjhalajhalāsalōṇāē
vālā sasimaṇidhīulliya vva sēulliyā jāyā // SubhāPajjSaṁ.3
navasaṅgaraṅganaṭṭāvaēṇa naccāviyā tahā ahayaṁ
māmi! mahaṁ ciya hiyayaṁ na vimhayaṁ jēṇa pamhusaï // SubhāPajjSaṁ.4
amayamaō vi hu dāhaṁ jaṇēi, sañjīvaṇō vi mōhēi
maüō vi vindhaï maṇaṁ, diṭṭhicchōhō mayacchīṇaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.5
aïvaṅkadīharā jaṇamaṇāiṁ mōhanti kulavahukaḍakkhā
aṇivāriyavisamavisā rōsāruṇakasiṇabhuyaga vva // SubhāPajjSaṁ.6
annēsiṁ sōhaggaṁ na sahanti, na dinti kahavi ya suhacchiṁ
jīyaṁ haranti virahē ahō! guṇā dujjaṇā tīē // SubhāPajjSaṁ.7
kuppanti vallahatthē apahuppantassa niyayaaṅgassa
annapahuppantassa ya puṇō asūyanti mihuṇāiṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.8
aṭṭhāṇaṭṭhanilayaṇaṁ visamiyasayaṇaṁ khalantamiuvayaṇaṁ
vārattanimiyanayaṇaṁ pacchannarayaṁ kahaṁ suhayaṁ? // SubhāPajjSaṁ.9
vallahajaṇassa dukkhē nisuē virahammi jāyaē sukkhaṁ
sukkhammi puṇō dukkhaṁ pimmassa gaī ahō! visamā // SubhāPajjSaṁ.10
jassantarāvayāsō gaüravadakkhinnadujjaṇajaṇāṇa
taṁ pi hu pemmaṁ ti bhaṇantayāṇa jīhā vi lajjēi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.11
taṁ suyaṇā jaṁ vasiyā si takkhaṇa ccēya tassa hiyayammi
sō dujjaṇō uṇa na jō ajja vi nivasēi tuha hiyaē // SubhāPajjSaṁ.12
maṁ pariciyaṁ pi ujjhiya dullahalambhē jaṇammi saṅkanta!
hā! hiyaya! hīṇasāhasa! lahasi tumaṁ dukkhalakkhāiṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.13
vallahasayavāsayamandirēsu sañjhabbhasarisarāēsu
purisahiyaēsu pemmāvandhō kō nāma vāmanayaṇāṇaṁ? // SubhāPajjSaṁ.14
[p. 77]
avarāhō vi hu vallahajaṇassa paramaṁ pamōyamappēi
ahiyaṁ harēi hiyaya dhūmō vi hu surahivatthūṇaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.15
jaggirasōhaggāṇaṁ aviṇayavāṇī vi varisaē harisaṁ
suhaḍanivakāyarō vi hu kiṁ na hu jayamajjaï jayammi? // SubhāPajjSaṁ.16
sō atthō jō hatthē, taṁ mittaṁ jaṁ nirantaraṁ vasaṇē
taṁ rūvaṁ jattha guṇā, ta vinnāṇaṁ jahiṁ dhammō // SubhāPajjSaṁ.17
sō suhaō paramappuvvillanihāṇaṁ va naṭṭhasallaṁ va
āsannō vi hu vihiō hayavihi! kaha nāma maha dūrē? // SubhāPajjSaṁ.18
dūraṭṭhiō vi su cciya maha hiyaē jalaharō vva sarasīē
sē vva ṇa naliṇīva ṇavaṇa[?]gaēhi kiṁ nāma annēhiṁ? // SubhāPajjSaṁ.19
kuviēṇa kayantēṇaṁ parivārē vāriyamminisisamayē
kulabāliyāē lajjā mahalliyā sahayarī hōi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.20
aïmuddhamaüyacavalō valantanayaṇāi tīē jantīē
diṭṭhicchōhō savisēsadūsahō vālabhuyagō vva // SubhāPajjSaṁ.21
saccaṁ raī ciya imā jamimīi mamaṁmaṇaṁ pi gayanayaṇaṁ
paharēi sō hayāsō visamēhiṁ sarēhi kusumasarō // SubhāPajjSaṁ.22
kōdaṇḍakōsalēṇaṁ sō ajja vi lajjiro cciya aṇaṅgō
jaṁ kira lakkhaṁ bhuyaṇāiṁ tinni, bāṇā puṇō pañca // SubhāPajjSaṁ.23
amayarasasāramullañciūṇa candāō tuha muhaṁ vihiyaṁ
tassa talaṁ jēṇa jaṇō suyaṇu! kalaṅko tti kittēi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.24
āyannāṇa guṇāṇaṁ raṇaraṇaō, sumaraṇammi dāhajarō
diṭṭhē hallapphalaō, miliyammi piyammi kimpi suhaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.25
diṭṭhaṁ siṇiddhanayaṇaṁ vayaṇaṁ viṇaōvarōhasōhillaṁ
karakamalakēsabandhō ya haraï dhīraṁ hiyāhintō // SubhāPajjSaṁ.26
ēsō aladdhadullahakāmō vāmēyarō karō phuriō
dāhiṇanayaṇakayatthassa tujjha kaha nāma vāmattaṁ? // SubhāPajjSaṁ.27
rūvaṁ nayaṇāṇa guṇā maṇassa avalōyaṇāiṁ caraṇāṇaṁ
ālavaṇaṁ savvaṅgassa bandhaṇaṁ tassa kiṁ bhaṇimō? // SubhāPajjSaṁ.28
[p. 78]
‘sumarijjasu’ tti pimmassa bāhiraṁ, ‘maha suhē’ti na ghaḍēi
‘mā khijjasu’ tti aṇuhavaviruddhamiha kiṁ bhaṇāmi ahaṁ? // SubhāPajjSaṁ.29
nayaṇāṇa vandhaṇaṁ maṇaviāraṇaṁ vēyaṇāi sammōhō
annāṇa dasaṇijjāṇa dujjaṇō tīya rūvasirī // SubhāPajjSaṁ.30
amayamayavayaṇamavirāmaramiyamaviyāravajjariyakajjaṁ
jayaï pahuttaṁ vālattaṇaṁ va pemma ca lōyammi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.31
gaṅgāsaṅgēṇa viṇā vi jalanihī hōi jalanihisayā
gaṅgā uṇa tēṇa viṇā bhaṇa kattha khaṇaṁ pi vīsamaü? // SubhāPajjSaṁ.32
ghariṇī lacchi vva mahānihi vva amayaṁ va punnamutti vva
jattha'tthi gharaṁ ta ciya, annaṁ rannaṁ ti mannanti // SubhāPajjSaṁ.33
tāō guṇāṇa khāṇī mahimaḍalamaṇḍaṇaṁ sumahilāō
dōsā vi jattha nihiyā guṇarūvēṇaṁ pariṇamanti // SubhāPajjSaṁ.34
tāṇa kulavāliyāṇaṁ na lahaï saccaṁ sahāvamahimāṇaṁ
jāṇa paḍivakkhacaḍiyā dōsā vi maṇaṁ na dūminti // SubhāPajjSaṁ.35
tāṇa namō samaṇīṇaṁ ājammaṁ cariyavambhacērāṇaṁ
pimmanaḍakavaḍanāḍayaviḍaṁvaṇā jāṇa na khaṇaṁ pi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.36
tīē tijayaṁ pi kīraü niuñchaṇaṁ picchulucchujaṭṭhīē
chittā vi pīliyā vi hu jā na hu mahurattaṇaṁ muaï // SubhāPajjSaṁ.37
mahilā pasāyagahilā sayampabhā hōi, na uṇa sappurisō
sasiṇā viṇā vi rayaṇī havaï, na divasō viṇā raviṇā // SubhāPajjSaṁ.38
mannāmi māmi! ki vā majjha kaē tujjha dukkaraṁ annaṁ?
suhayassamajjhajaṁ kira appā vi samappiō tumaē // SubhāPajjSaṁ.39
taṁ dacchanti saharisaṁ kayāvarāhaṁ ahaṁ ti savilakkhaṁ
puṇaravi caraṇaṁ disa rōsa māmi! nalamāṇasaṁ taïyā[?] // SubhāPajjSaṁ.40
taṇhāē[?]taralanayaṇō parissamē, añcalammi valahatthō
dukkhē sattō, dhammammi vimhiō, tuha suhē suhiō // SubhāPajjSaṁ.41
jūyaṁ dhaṇāṇa, vasaṇaṁ guṇāṇa, paḍipatthaṇōvayārāṇa
vatthuviyārō pimmāṇa māṇamummūlaï samūlaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.42
lajjā kulamajjāyā dunni kavāḍāiṁ jēhiṁ bhaggāiṁ
hiyaēsu tēsu sahasa tti dukkhamakkhaliyamalliyaï // SubhāPajjSaṁ.43
[p. 79]
pimmassa pōḍhamahilājaṇassa vihavassa vārivāhassa
paramappaṇō maṇassa ya muṇanti muṇiṇō viṇayarūvaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.44
titthāṇa supurisāṇaṁ maṇīṇa santāṇamōsahīṇaṁ ca
mahimā mahāsaīṇaṁ ca kālakalusassa dūrēṇaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.45
nayaraṁ mahūsavamayaṁ, tucchā lacchī, maṇaṁ mahārambhaṁ
vihinihiyaṁ maha hiyaē tisallayaṁ sallaē ēyaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.46
vittavivāhaṁ ca gihaṁ, payapabbhaṭṭhō ya naravaïniōī
gayajovvaṇā ya mahilā na puvvasōhaṁ pi hu lahanti // SubhāPajjSaṁ.47
vihavaṅgaṇāṇa gabbhō, niddhaṇavaṅgāṇa dāṇavasaṇāiṁ
ja ca khavaṇāṇa kuccaṁ taṁ amayachalaṁ halāhalayaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.48
aïkiviṇō cēya tumaṁ jaṁ ikkammi vi guṇammi ghippantē
apparimāṇaguṇō vi hu vahasi muhamahōmuhaṁ nāha! // SubhāPajjSaṁ.49
na hu tuha guṇē gahissaṁ[?]duṇha pi jāṇa gahaṇammi
tuha gahaṇāsahaṇēṇaṁ maha uṇa aïmucchagahaṇēṇaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.50
samaratimirammi sahalaṁ dūyaṁ piva pēsiūṇa pattavahaṁ
ahisāraï riulacchiṁ mahalliyā jassa cāvalayā // SubhāPajjSaṁ.51
taïṁ giṇhiya cāvalaē riūṇa lacchī ti gahiyacāvalayā
rattā tumammi naravaï! darisaï sarisattaṇaṁ nūṇaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.52
unnamiūṇa nahayalē jalahara! tuha gajjiya pi chajjēi
vajjēṇa dahiumamaēṇa siñciuṁ vayasi ja bhuyaṇaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.53
jaï vihavīṇa viṇīyaṁ diṭṭhipahē kahavi vaccaï avaccaṁ
tā amaya-canda-candima-candaṇapaṅkēhiṁ na hu kipi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.54
mannanti duhaṁ pi suhaṁ mahilāō avaccanēhagahilāō
parabālalālaṇaṁ pi hu ja kira vajhāō jhāyati // SubhāPajjSaṁ.55
dhannāō tāō kulavāliyāō nimmahiyamōhamahimāō
diṭṭha na viyaḍabhiuḍīpuḍakiyaṁ jāhi paravayaṇa // SubhāPajjSaṁ.56
muttu mālaïpamuhaṁ kusumasamūhaṁ mahūsavadiṇēsu
ekka ciya gijjaï bāliyāhiṁ nōmāliyākusumaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.57
suhaḍanarindapayāvō sumantajāvō pasūṇasaracāvō
taha ya mahāsaïsāvō mā kayamavvō! niyattēi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.58
[p. 80]
niccaṁ varisasu dāṇaṁ kuṇēsu gamaṇaṁ maṇōharagaīē
daṁsasu dasaṇē cavalē! jaï si suhatthī-maṁ bhaddē! // SubhāPajjSaṁ.59
vērīṇaṁ maraṇabhayaṁ, bandhūṇa maṇōrahō, suhaṁ haliṇō
gōvīṇa vallaharasō, kaṇhēṇa sama vivaḍḍhanti // SubhāPajjSaṁ.60
pīūsappamuhāṇa vi suyaṇō dippēvi dēi dōhaggaṁ
ruṭṭhōvi dujjaṇō uṇa dahaṇāīṇaṁ pi sōhaggaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.61
mahimaṁ mahāsaīṇaṁ kiṁ bhaṇimō jāṇa pāṇimāhappā
ārambhō mokkhaphalō jāyaï, lacchī vi kāmaduhā // SubhāPajjSaṁ.62
uvajujjanti kayā vi hu na hi jē pattēsu kaha vi pattēsu
caṇḍālakūvajalasacchahēhi kiṁ tēhi vihavēhiṁ? // SubhāPajjSaṁ.62
vihaliyasāhārattaṁ ki bhaṇimō tāṇa dujjaṇajaṇāṇaṁ
duhiya-suhiēhiṁ mukkē suha-dukkhē jēsu allīṇē // SubhāPajjSaṁ.63
dāṇaṁ dīṇuddharaṇaṁ āgamasavaṇaṁ sutitthajattā ya
pavayaṇabhattī a maṇussajammataruṇō phalasamiddhī // SubhāPajjSaṁ.64
kiṁ tēṇāvi ghaḍijjaï jō na hu sabbhāvarasanisittō vi
purisō ya puhaïpiṇḍō va bhijjiō appamappēi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.65
viyaliyadhaṇāṇa dāṇaṁ, jarajajjarajuvvaṇāṇa pariṇayaṇaṁ
maraṇasaraṇāṇa dhammō, kisikammaṁ sarayasamayammi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.66
aviyali[ya]mappaṇu cciya sayalāō suhaṁ mahanti mahilāō
niyapaïṇo cciya suhamahilasanti jā tāō puṇa viralā // SubhāPajjSaṁ.67
jē varisantē vi ciraṁ pukkhalamēhē gurussa amiyarasaṁ
bhijjanti kimpi na hu muggasēlasīlāṇa tāṇa namō // SubhāPajjSaṁ.68
jaha sajalamēhalēhāē pāusō, māhavīē mahusamaō
taha lahaï siriṁ purisō guṇavaṇadharaṇīē ghariṇīē // SubhāPajjSaṁ.69
pimmaṁ ta ciya jāyanti jattha dōsā vi naṇu guṇa ccēya
siddharasō sō kira jattha hunti lōhāiṁ vi suvannaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.70
tē kē vi kamaliṇīē vi havanti santāvadīharā diyahā
mittō vi jēsu saha jīvaṇēṇa jīyaṁ pi saṁharaï // SubhāPajjSaṁ.71
supurisabhariyāē vi niṭṭhiyāē vambhaṇḍabhaṇḍasālāē
sampaï purisā kamasō avayaramiyaru vva uvvariyā[?] // SubhāPajjSaṁ.72
[p. 81]
virahēṇaṁ ciya piyasaṅgasāṇa sōhaggamahiyamullasaï
gimhēṇaṁ ciya sīyalajalāṇa mahamahaï māhappaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.74
dappō guṇāṇa, niddā suyāṇa, vasaṇaṁ gurūvaēsāṇa
paṇasundarī dhaṇāṇaṁ, lōhō sukkhāṇa khayavāhī // SubhāPajjSaṁ.75
pūnantā dēsantarēhi suhu sāmuhaüṁ hasēi
punnahīṇu puṇu niyagharaha bhittari bhuvakha bhamēi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.76
baddhā gāḍhaṁ, gūḍhaṁ ca dhāriyā, nihaṇiyā ya khaḍḍāē
khaṇḍīkayā ya kiviṇēṇa kaha va na vi mōciyā lacchī // SubhāPajjSaṁ.77
īsā-visāya-bhaya-kōha-[lōha-]annāṇa-māṇa-mayaṇēhiṁ
sasāranāḍayanaḍā naccāvijjanti jantugaṇā // SubhāPajjSaṁ.78
annāyaguṇavisēsammi sāmiē kiṁ kuṇanti guṇavantā?
putti! na muttiyamagghaï guñjāharaṇē pulindammi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.79
kiṁ dullahamuvaēsō, kiṁ dūrē? jaṁ maṇassa uvviddhaṁ
kiṁ rammaṁ? jattha raī, kimuvvasaṁ? jattha na hu suyaṇō // SubhāPajjSaṁ.80
gāṇaṁ kaṇṭhapamāṇaṁ, māṇaṁ pimmāṇumāṇamiha suhayaṁ
jāṇaṁ āsaṇanāṇaṁ[?], dāṇaṁ niyavibhavaparimāṇaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.81
tāva hu sīlaṁ lajjā gurūvaēsā vasanti hiyayammi
lōyassa ē ṇa jaggaï jaṭharaggipalīvaṇaṁ jāva // SubhāPajjSaṁ.82
sasiṇēhadēhadahaṇē kiṁ bhaṇimō tassa virahadahaṇassa?
jassa paḍiyārakaraṇē vi ānalō candaṇarasō vva // SubhāPajjSaṁ.83
candamuhi! amayavayaṇē! nīluppalanayaṇi! rambhakhambhōru!
virahavihiyammi hiyaē nihiyā vi hu kaha ṇu taṁ tavasi? // SubhāPajjSaṁ.84
viṇaēhi guṇēhintō vi nūṇa taṁ cēva sasimuhi! mahagghā
jaṁ tē vi taē gahiyā amayaṁ visaṁ va puṇṇarahiyā[?] // SubhāPajjSaṁ.85
ahaha! maha maṇuyajammō musiō mūḍhassa visayacōrēhiṁ
andhassa va vaṇiṇō khajjamāvaṇā ḍimbharūēhiṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.86
[p. 82]
jā kuḍilanīyagamaṇā taṁ jālayaṁ pi muttumōsaraï[?]
sā tumaē maïparihīṇa! mīṇa! sariyā kahaṁ mariyā[?] // SubhāPajjSaṁ.87
vēhavvaniccadukkhaṁ va vīyaghariṇittaṇaṁ va dahiūṇa
sampaï païmmi vihiē vahāmi sōyaṁ pamōyaṁ vā // SubhāPajjSaṁ.88
īsarasiripattō vi hu tuha mahaṇijjō vi pa[a]mayamottī vi
punnattaṇaṁ na pāvaï sasī jaḍāsaṅgadōsēṇa // SubhāPajjSaṁ.89
ahaha! vihiṇō paüttaṁ jaṁ sayamavi nimmiyammi kammammi
ciṭṭhantu samōvāyāvallahaparidēviyavvammi // SubhāPajjSaṁ.90
jē nivvāsaviyā vi hu khaṇanti dūrē kayā dahanti jaṇaṁ
tēsu visaēsu rāhava! nāha! vaṇaṁ jujjaï buhāṇaṁ // SubhāPajjSaṁ.91
